title: cissus assamica
intro: Cissus assamica, commonly known as Adam's apple or Veld grape, is a perennial vine native to the tropical forests of Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving bone density, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Cissus assamica are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and display anti-inflammatory and antiseptic actions. The bioactive constituents of Cissus assamica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
